instruction: Candid street photograph, medium full shot. On an outdoor city sidewalk, the man with dark curly hair in a light brown jacket (R1) stands in the center background with arms outstretched, pointing to both sides and smiling. On the right, the man with glasses and a dark brown jacket (R2) stands in profile, pointing his left hand towards the left. They pose in a dramatic pointing standoff under natural overcast daylight.
